|translation='''Title:''' Echo Base trooper officer.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. After that, may move anywhere. Echo Base Troopers deploy -1 to the same location. Your troopers may move as a react toward the same Hoth location as the officer.

'''Lore:'''
Most Rebel specialists, like Trey Callum, are former Imperial officers who defected. Trooper officers are skilled at putting the Rebellion's scarce supplies to good use.
